convert_fuyu_checkpoint: convert a Fuyu Adept checkpoint to HuggingFace format using the CLI with input, output, and model paths
rename_state_dict: rename state dict keys to map Adept Fuyu model keys to HuggingFace FuyuForCausalLM key names
main: run the CLI script to convert Fuyu model weights and tokenizer from Adept format to HuggingFace format
build_fuyu_model_from_checkpoint: build a FuyuForCausalLM model in HuggingFace format from an Adept .pt checkpoint file
save_fuyu_tokenizer: save a LlamaTokenizer with custom bos and eos tokens for the converted Fuyu model
